webui.signInBody: Kinopeer runs in qBittorrent’s Web UI: sign in with its username and password.
webui.signInFailed: qBittorrent didn’t sign you in. Try again.
webui.storeFull: qBittorrent’s store for web interfaces is full: it holds 1 MiB for all of them. Another interface used with this qBittorrent may have filled it.
webui.prowlarrStoreFull: Prowlarr’s address and key weren’t saved. $t(webui.storeFull)
webui.defaultsStoreFull: Saved in this browser, not in qBittorrent, whose value may come back when the page is reloaded. $t(webui.storeFull)
webui.matchHint: Your choice is kept in qBittorrent and shows on every device that signs in to it.
webui.tmdbKeyBody: Posters, search and metadata come from The Movie Database. Kinopeer’s own key works only when qBittorrent is opened at a local address, so here use a free API key (v3) or read access token of your own. Kinopeer keeps it in qBittorrent.
webui.tmdbKeyFieldHelp: Kinopeer checks it with TMDB, then keeps it in qBittorrent for every device that signs in to it.
webui.tmdbKeyNeeded: Search needs a TMDB key. Enter it once, and Kinopeer keeps it in qBittorrent.
webui.prowlarrSetupBody: Kinopeer finds releases through Prowlarr. Enter its address as this browser reaches it, and its API key. Without Prowlarr everything works but finding releases.
webui.prowlarrAddressHelp: As this browser reaches it, for example http://192.168.1.10:9696
webui.prowlarrKeyFieldHelp: Kinopeer checks it with Prowlarr, then keeps it in qBittorrent, where this browser reads it to call Prowlarr.
webui.linkFiles: Prowlarr gave a link qBittorrent fetches itself, so all files are downloaded; you can skip files on the torrent’s page later. If the torrent doesn’t show up in downloads, qBittorrent couldn’t fetch the link: try another release.
webui.prowlarrKeySeen: Without a Kinopeer server, the browser calls Prowlarr with its key, so anyone with qBittorrent’s login, a browser extension or a release’s link can see it. Keep Prowlarr on your home network, on HTTPS where you can.
webui.prowlarrMixedContent: qBittorrent is open over HTTPS, so the browser won’t call Prowlarr over HTTP. Enter Prowlarr’s HTTPS address.
